query_text: What is the capital of France?

message.content:
The capital of France is **Paris**.

Paris is located in the north-central part of France along the banks of the Seine River, at the heart of the Île-de-France region. It has been the capital of France since 508 A.D. under King Clovis, with a brief interruption during World War II (1940-1944) when the capital was moved to Vichy during the German occupation. Paris serves as France's political, economic, and cultural center, housing key government institutions including the President's residence at the Élysée Palace and the French Parliament.
